{
  "conventions": [
    "Format all TypeScript, JavaScript, JSON, and Markdown files with Prettier (@backstage/cli/config/prettier: 2-space indent, single quotes in TS/JS, trailing commas).",
    "Never run lint commands with --fix; never run yarn build, changesets version, or release.",
    "Every new source file must start with the standard Backstage Apache 2.0 copyright header (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors).",
    "Workspace package.json peerDependencies for @types/react, react, and react-dom must be exactly \"^18.0.0\".",
    "Author changesets directly as Markdown files in .changeset/ (never via the changeset CLI) and exclude private packages (app-example-plugin, @internal/plugin-todo-list)."
  ],
  "decisions": [
    {
      "topic": "React peerDependency range across workspace packages and repo-tools peer-deps linter",
      "choice": "Set @types/react, react, and react-dom in peerDependencies to '^18.0.0' in all 56 workspace package.json files and in packages/repo-tools/src/commands/peer-deps/peer-deps.ts, removing peerDependenciesReact18Only, react18OnlyPackages, and getExpectedPeerDependencies.",

        "Retaining react18OnlyPackages with all packages added to the set",
        "Widening peerDependencies to include React 19"
      ],
      "reason": "All published frontend packages now uniformly require React 18, making the per-package React 18 allowlist redundant while keeping React 19 out of scope."
